project_info.theme: YSL Libre Atrium special performance event poster

main_subject.detail: A luxury event poster with a black marble-and-gold-crack background. On the right is a real-photo portrait of a platinum blond male performer wearing a deep-open black leather jacket and layered silver cross necklaces. On the left are the exact lines 'LIBRE ATRIUM', 'SPECIAL PERFORMANCE', 'WREN EVANS', '18h30 ngày 28.10', and the venue box 'Tầng 1, Saigon Centre' with address '92-94 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Quận 1, TPHCM'.
